body:
> From the review of PR #172 (#164, merged 2026-08-29). One-line fixes; none blocked the merge.

## What

1. `src/up.js` ~221 — the "not running" branch of `down` re-reads the pid file and `rmSync`s it unconditionally. Between `processState` and that read a concurrent `hkb up` (or the child's own `claimServePid`/`acquireLoopLock`) can write a fresh live pid, and `down` would drop a live process's claim — the invariant the file header forbids. Guard it: `const f = readPidFile(root, name); if (f.pid && (f.stale || !pidAlive(f.pid))) rmSync(…)`. Test: write a live pid into the file after `processState` was taken (inject the read) and assert the file survives.
2. `src/up.js` ~122 — `up` leaves the pid file it wrote naming the corpse it just reported as `failed` (observed `serve.pid` holding a dead pid). It verified that pid dead and owns the claim: tidy it there, pid-guarded the same way.
3. `src/up.js` ~224 — for a stale pid file the human line still says "hkb up replaces it" right after `down` removed it; say "removed".
4. `src/model.js` ~973 `deadAtRecheck` returns `{name,pid,log,line}` and `up.js` re-picks three fields; return `{ line, failed: {name,pid,log} }` and add a direct unit test in `test/model.test.js` (CLAUDE.md: pure logic gets a test).
5. `docs/wiki/features/up-and-down.md`: line anchors drifted (ESRCH ~228-235, tidy ~217-224, `up` ~144-170, `down` ~203-258) and the page is stale on main after the merge — re-verify and re-stamp; add the 300 ms recheck window to Known limits (a child that dies after the recheck is reported started, exit 0).

## Done when

- `down` with a pid file rewritten to a live pid between the state read and the tidy leaves the file in place (test).
- `up --serve --port 80` leaves no `serve.pid`; `--status` says stopped.
- `npm run lint && npm test` green; wiki-check shows up-and-down.md fresh.
goal: Neither up nor down ever removes a pid file that names a live process, and the wiki page for up/down is fresh with correct line anchors
title: hkb down: never drop a pid file without checking the pid is dead; hkb up: tidy the corpse it just reported
